commands.name: produce
commands.description: Make a new motion video end to end (research, concept, character, build, score, verify). Default for any new video.

commands.name: research
commands.description: Collect verbatim copy, product facts, limits and brand truth from the subject's public web.

commands.name: concept
commands.description: Pitch, pick and write the brief, design spec, storyboard and the shared timing/geometry spine.

commands.name: character
commands.description: Turn a supplied avatar or mascot into a validated, rigged vector character.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Write the compositions (hook, stage or chat, surfaces, finale) on the spine, with handoffs.

commands.name: score
commands.description: Synthesize a procedural score and sound marks cut to the spine, place SFX, normalize loudness.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Run the gates (lint, snapshots, check, render, frames, loudness) and write the delivery report.
